description: Complete MCU documentation for Artery AT32F403A/407 ARM Cortex-M4 microcontrollers with firmware library containing 1,985 working examples, peripheral driver references, and comprehensive taxonomy system for semantic search.
rules: Always consult the official AT32F403A/407 errata sheet (ES0002 v2.0.11) from Artery Technology before implementing Flash, CAN, or PWC peripherals
For Flash operations: Never place sLib in Non-Zero-Wait (NZW) area, always disable interrupts during NZW Flash erase, and place erase code in Zero-Wait (ZW) area or RAM
For CAN communication: Implement workaround for reception failure using mailbox priority or lock/unlock method to prevent message loss during retransmission
For Power Management (PWC): Remove AHB frequency division before entering Deepsleep mode to prevent wake-up failure
For SPIM (SPI Flash interface): Always disable interrupts during external Flash erase operations to prevent CPU read errors
Check if issues are fixed in Revision B before implementing workarounds - 39% of known issues are resolved in hardware revision B
Always initialize peripherals using the provided firmware library drivers (at32f403a_407_*.c/h) rather than direct register access
Use the working code examples from AT32F403A_407_Firmware_Library/project/ as reference implementations for each peripheral
Refer to peripheral relationship mappings in docs/taxonomy/ to understand dependencies between peripherals (e.g., CAN requires GPIO and CRM configuration)
For production designs, download the latest official errata sheet from Artery Technology website and implement all documented high-priority workarounds
